show.description: A woman discovers her husband cheating with her best friend and pretends to lose her memory. To cover up his betrayal, her husband lies that she is married to his wealthy friend. As everyone continues a web of lies, she secretly plots her revenge. However, as she grows closer to the man she’s been falsely paired with, real emotions begin to develop, threatening to change her plan completely.
